thread:
Elena Park: Quick design question — posted a small screencap of the console row: primary CTA feels visually heavy next to the secondary. Also noticed a toast sometimes renders behind the modal on desktop. Thoughts?

Mike Chen: agree — the primary is dominating the row. Feels dense. Maybe reduce horizontal padding and try the ghost treatment on the secondary? :thinking_face:

Toni Alvarez: accessibility note: toasts should be announced but not steal focus. For screen readers we should use role="status" / aria-live="polite" and avoid focusing the toast. Also the ghost button contrast on the gray surface looks low to me.

Samir Patel: is the current horizontal padding for CTAs tokenized? I think we're using --space-button-h: 16px. Propose --space-cta: 12px for compact rows (dashboards, tables). Also recommend changing CTA copy from "Run" to "Run check" (more explicit) in this flow. Small copy tweak reduces confusion.

Elena Park: good calls. Can we get a quick spec: spacing token change + color/copy options? Want to ship this with the next console patch.

DesignBot: Accessibility scan: ghost-button text #6B7280 on surface #F3F4F6 has contrast ratio 3.9:1 (WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for normal text). Flagged as "contrast-fail".

Mike Chen: easy fix — either darken the text to #374151 or lighten the bg to #FFFFFF. I prefer darkening text so shadows stay consistent.

Toni Alvarez: also, about the toast behind modal — screen reader behavior we saw: when modal opens and a toast fires immediately, some SRs read the toast then the modal, which is jarring. Two options: delay toast announce until modal animation complete (~250-350ms) or set toast to aria-live="polite" and ensure modal gets focus after open. I'd vote for a 300ms defer.

Samir Patel: code suggestion for tokens and a small delay: 
```css
:root {
  --space-cta: 12px; /* compact */
  --space-cta-regular: 16px;
  --toast-announce-delay-ms: 300;
}

/* JS: defer toast announce */
setTimeout(() => showToast('Saved'), getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--toast-announce-delay-ms'))
```

Elena Park: love it. I'll make a tiny PR: token change + copy update + accessibility note about toast delay. Will include two visual options (darken text vs lighten bg) for the ghost variant.

Samir Patel: I'll review the PR — can you include a Percy snapshot for both color options and the compact spacing?

Toni Alvarez: please include the aria attributes in the markup example and add test steps for VoiceOver/JAWS.

Elena Park: will do. Thanks all.

Mike Chen: :thumbsup:

Toni Alvarez: :eyes:
